paper_title: EssayBench Evaluating Large Language Models in Multi-Genre Chinese   Essay Writing
caption: Dataset Statistics. Note that Open denotes Open-Ended sets, Cons. refers to Constrained sets.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма илюстрира разпределението на броя проби по четири различни типа текстове - Аргументативен, Наративен, Дескриптивен и Експозитивен, като ги сравнява между два набора данни: „Open“ (отворени) и „Cons.“ (конструирани). Хоризонталната ос показва четирите типа текстове без определена последователност, докато вертикалната ос представлява броя на пробите, етикетирана като „Sample Count“, с диапазон от стойности от 0 до 140 и скала на интервали от 20. За двата набора данни са отчетени следните стойности: за „Open“ - 79, 80, 68 и 62, докато за „Cons.“ - 122, 87, 100 и 130 съответно за четирите типа текстове; стълбите са оцветени в две различни цветови групи според типа на набора, без допълнителни визуални акценти като засенчване или удебеляване; диаграмата предоставя преглед на това как се разпределят пробите в различните типове текстове и какви са числените съотношения между отворения и конструирания набор.
model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates the distribution of sample counts across four text genres, comparing Open-Ended and Constrained sets. The horizontal axis lists the genres: Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository, representing the categories being compared. The vertical axis, labeled "Sample Count," has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120, with regularly spaced tick labels at intervals of 20. The chart features two color-coded series: blue bars for Open-Ended sets and pink bars for Constrained sets. The blue bars have the following approximate values: 79 for Argumentative, 80 for Narrative, 68 for Descriptive, and 62 for Expository. The pink bars have the following values: 122 for Argumentative, 87 for Narrative, 100 for Descriptive, and 130 for Expository. The bars are grouped by genre, with each genre having a pair of adjacent bars representing the Open-Ended and Constrained sets. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and labeling; the Constrained set for Expository and the Open-Ended set for Narrative are among the tallest and shortest, respectively.
model_annotations.German: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of sample counts across different genres in both open-ended and constrained datasets. The horizontal axis represents four distinct genres - Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository - while the vertical axis, labeled "Sample Count," ranges from 0 to 120 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20. Each genre is represented by two bars: a blue bar for "Open" (open-ended) and a pink bar for "Cons." (constrained). The "Open" bars have values of 79, 80, 68, and 62 for Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository genres, respectively, with the highest value being 80 for Narrative and the lowest being 62 for Expository. The "Cons." bars have corresponding values of 122, 87, 100, and 130, with Expository having the highest count and Narrative the lowest among the constrained sets. The bars are grouped by genre, allowing for a direct comparison between the open-ended and constrained datasets for each genre. The chart does not display any specific sorting order among the genres, and all bars are presented with clear labels and colors, making the data easily interpretable.
